outputs.discrepancies: Caption states the violin plots show 'log2 enrichment ratio (HTT IP vs mIgG IP)' for all four antibody groups (EPR5526, 2B7-4C9, 4E10-3E10, and D7F7). However, the right-hand violin plot (D7F7) is explicitly labeled on its y-axis as 'Abundance vs. rIgG (Log2)', i.e., compared to rabbit IgG, not mouse IgG (mIgG) as stated generally in the caption. The left three antibody groups are correctly plotted vs. mIgG, so the caption's blanket 'vs mIgG' description does not accurately describe the D7F7 sub-panel.

The panel legend includes a fourth marker category, dark-blue circles labeled 'Consortium', in addition to the categories 'HTT' (red), '2/3 AP-MS' (teal/light blue), and '++' (orange). The caption only describes three categories (bait HTT in red, selected positive controls in orange, and proteins annotated in ≥2/3 of prior HTT IP-MS studies in light blue) and does not mention or explain the 'Consortium' category that is visibly plotted in the panel.
